item.title: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hullo! My name is John.

I was introduced to skips maybe three years ago. Since then, I’ve always been coming up with different ideas for them, mostly lost to time. As you can maybe, possibly tell from my username, I especially like the Fifth Church. I also like ARGs, Xx_gaming_xX, and generally mucking about. I’m not much for writing- I’m more of an ideas person- so hopefully the collaborative element of the site will come in if I ever do post anything. I also edit ok.

I would like to say that I’m fire. I can’t. I’m more akin to earth. It’s always there. It supports heavy weights constantly, both the weight of man and the weight of nature, until it can no longer do so. Earth is really just a nice word for dirt. Rocks too, but dirt is at least what first comes to mind for me. It’s rarely the first choice. Fire is exciting and gives off sparks, air is above everything and has a kind of mystical quality to it, water can take exciting and creative forms. Earth is slow-moving. It nurtures and once it’s angry it stays that way, but there’s nothing much to it- at least not to the human eye. look, this ain’t really accurate, it said most representative

It’s a pleasure to introduce myself to y’all!

item.title: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hello DrRobbieKB, welcome to the site! Don't stress too much on doing a good job, we are all here to have fun and help each other create great and interesting pieces of the site. The staff here is very fridnly and helpful so never worry about reaching out for help if you need it!
As for writing, just make sure you go through the proper greenlighting process on the idea forums first. Remember that there is no rush, and you should take time familiarizing yourself with how Series 6 articles are formatted. We are a rather unique bunch so I'm sure just reading and being a part of the community will be rather fun for you! For my recommendation, you should check out SCP-4703 an SCP that is a totally legal and normal store with nothing out of the ordinary.

+ Resources
- Hide Resources

If you're going to try your hand at writing, try out our sandbox. You can make yourself a page here to store your drafts.

Sandbox

For hashing out concepts, try out the Ideas and Brainstorming forum. You can run your ideas by the community if you need help refining your concept.

If you have a draft ready, make a thread in the Drafts and Critiques forum. Remember to check the stickied posts in the relevant thread for guidelines on how best to use each forum. You can also try the IRC chat for real-time feedback.

From site usage to writing tips, the Guide Hub contains a wealth of resources geared towards helping members produce successful articles.

The more time you take to familiarize yourself with the SCP style, the drafting process, and the community, the greater your chances are for success!

As far as reading is concerened, you might want to check out our Top Rated New Pages, which will display the most popular, recent articles. It's helpful to keep up with what's being received well by the community.

Best of luck!

It's always good to hear that you have your own SCP ideas already, but there is never a rush to come up with ideas. There are plenty of great tales to get lost in, and if you were looking for more I would suggest checking out the Canon Hub for some neat little universes people have created. Fire is a wonderful element, that can be interpreted in many ways. Most people see it as bad, but fire can also symbolize passion.
As for writing, just make sure you go through the proper greenlighting process on the idea forums first. Remember that there is no rush, and you should take time familiarizing yourself with how Series 6 articles are formatted. We are a rather unique bunch so I'm sure just reading and being a part of the community will be rather fun for you! For my recommendation, you should check out SCP-5992 an interesting concept relating to Greek mythology, with a side of interesting exploration logs.

item.title: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hello! You can refer to me as Archivist Tündér or just Tündér [TOON-dair].

I was introduced to the SCP Foundation over the past few months from multiple writer and other creative friends, and have been exploring the universe via various Youtube channels such as SCP Animation, The Exploration Series, and TheVolgun. I've joined the wiki in the hope of writing some SCP articles, adding additional testing ideas to existing SCPs, eventually creating some tales surrounding the character Archivist Tündér and their role within the Foundation. I'm excited to expand my writing style with some of the different formats used across the wiki.

Question Answer: Water because it signifies change, a tempestuous nature, and the eventual breaking down of things once considered to be incapable of erosion.

item.title: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Greetings, my real name will be redacted for anonymity purposes; but you can call me Dr. Recoil instead. I joined this site because I wanted to read and write skips, and stories about the SCPverse as well.

I've always have an interest in writing and creating my own fictional world with great themes ever since I was young, and after discovering this modern day - internet equivalent of Lovecraft's works just last year, that interest/another hobby of mine has just grown ten folds.

Since we're already talking about hobbies, I would like to mention that I love playing video games and actual ones as well; such as chess. I also have a amateur-ish skill when it comes to video editing.

I would also like to mention that I am not very flexible with English yet at leas, since I am still a student and from a different country as well. Just a heads up in case someone ask me in the future about any possible mistakes in any of my post in the site (though, I'll certainly make sure that that won't frequently happen in my stories here).

Anyways, that's all I have to say. I am looking forward on working with you guys, and once again, thanks for accepting me.

P.S. The element I chose to associate with myself is Air , due to it being virtually invisible unless it decided to make it's presence known, by either helping you breathe or creating strong winds kinda edgy, I know. but that's the way it is ¯\_(ツ)_/¯. Also for the fact that it can be extremely flexible in finding a way out when contained.

I have an experience in writing, despite English not being my first language, in fact I'm an author at wattpad though not that yet well known, some people like my work. I've joined the SCP Foundation because I find all of the SCP awesome, and it seems to be one of the best place to let my mind run wild, as I happened to have an wild mind both figuratively and literary, that it even makes me afraid of heights even in truth I'm not afraid of it, by making me have thousands of thought on how I could die in high places ,weird, I know.

I like reading stuff as long as its interesting, I even make my own characters to get my mind to calm down (I have enough superhero character to make a series like the Avengers tho the low quality version of it.).

And last, I want to be here to get to know the SCPverse more, to share my ideas, and to get more experience in writing.

item.title: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers

Hello y'all, my name is DrTweed. I originally found this site when I was 13 and I completely forgot about it until I saw references to the SCP Foundation on TikTok believe it or not.

I don't read a lot anymore or write so much either, but I'd like to see myself as an above average writer. My biggest influence for writing style has most definitely been H.P. Lovecraft. I'm also a biochemistry major trying to become a drug researcher/developer so I thought it'd be fun to read and write some "science-y SCPs."

I really just hope I can bring a part of me to the site and leave a mark somehow!

As for the elements, Earth definitely represents me the best just because I'm a stubborn and enduring person and I feel like Earth/rocks personify that.

item.title: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hello! I'm Arlin Bradley. I'm a historian who adores academic prose. My experience writing pulp horror makes SCP an interesting intersection of interests for me. On one hand, I wanna write horrific new SCPs and Tales until my fingers start bleeding. However, I'm also interested in editing existing stories (spelling, grammar, etc.) to improve the overall quality of the site.

Random facts for the nosey! My favorite horror movie is Tucker and Dale vs. Evil, my favorite horror manga is Tomie by Junji Ito, and my favorite horror novel is Frankenstein by Mary Shelley. My top-rated creepypasta, Plaguespreader, peaked at #11 on r/shortscarystories and currently sits at #18. Your Name by Makoto Shinkai has thrice made me cry and I'll defend romantic comedies to my dying breath.

Hello! While my account name is ShadyFoliose, I definitely use "Shady" in all of my online names so I usually respond with that.

I've been a fan of the SCP community and following its development since around 2010 so I'm really excited to now be apart it! I finally made up my mind that I would like to contribute to this project, ideally through writing but really in whatever way I can.

I'm a geology major, biology minor (botany focused), and GIS minor. Despite my STEM focus, I have been writing as a hobby for quite a while with more horror themes. I look forward to hopefully writing some tales.

Finally, if I was a classical element I'd have to say water. I've been a competitive swimmer and swim coach so most of my life has been water oriented. I also consider myself rather "flexible" with most things.

I look forward to writing and working with/engaging with everyone!

item.title: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers

Hey, I'm bubba808. I am a new user on the SCP wiki user that just got accepted today on 11/24/20. It's possible I will change the name of my account in the future, but people can always refer to me as bubba or bubba808 and I will respond.

item.title: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Good evening beautiful people. I'll be using the handle Influrrno (Before you ask, yes, I came up with that because I like fire and ice motifs just a little too much, and yes, my writing will probably reflect that).

+ show block
– hide block

I've only recently been exposed to SCP, but I've always been taken in by unconventional writing formats that breed creativity, so I've been reading up on my skips and tales over the past few months and having a good time.

My ideas for writing SCPs and tales are… well, I'm pretty sure they're mostly a complete mess conceptually (let's just say I have an idea relating to a steel cable that puts holes in people but also its own plot), but I consider myself at least competent in technical writing style, so we'll have to see how this goes. I'm extremely excited to get and give productive feedback, as I'm a strong believer in improvement by acknowledging your own shortcomings.

To answer the forum's question, my classical element would definitely be Earth. I'd like to think that's because I'm steadfast, consistent and solid, but I suspect it's more because I just don't like to move much.


Anyway, hopefully I end up contributing something interesting to the site, or failing that, a bit of friendliness. Cheers mates!

item.title: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hey Mikhail Radzinsky, welcome to the SCP wiki! You seem rather soft spoken, but we are glad to have you here and eagerly await your additions to the site! Try not to burn anything while you're here.
As for writing, just make sure you go through the proper greenlighting process on the idea forums first. Remember that there is no rush, and you should take time familiarizing yourself with how Series 6 articles are formatted. We are a rather unique bunch so I'm sure just reading and being a part of the community will be rather fun for you! For my recommendation, you should check out SCP-5005 its one that adds a sense of mystery, and makes you wonder how someone thought this up.

+ Resources
- Hide Resources

If you're going to try your hand at writing, try out our sandbox. You can make yourself a page here to store your drafts.

Sandbox

For hashing out concepts, try out the Ideas and Brainstorming forum. You can run your ideas by the community if you need help refining your concept.

If you have a draft ready, make a thread in the Drafts and Critiques forum. Remember to check the stickied posts in the relevant thread for guidelines on how best to use each forum. You can also try the IRC chat for real-time feedback.

From site usage to writing tips, the Guide Hub contains a wealth of resources geared towards helping members produce successful articles.

The more time you take to familiarize yourself with the SCP style, the drafting process, and the community, the greater your chances are for success!

As far as reading is concerened, you might want to check out our Top Rated New Pages, which will display the most popular, recent articles. It's helpful to keep up with what's being received well by the community.

Best of luck!

item.title: Re: NOVEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hihi my name is flumbles! Ever since I accidentally stumbled on this place in early high school and consequentially had to sleep with a light on for at least 2 weeks I've been a longtime lurker on this place. While the sheer terror from the things I read here has waned, my appreciation for this place hasn't, and I've finally pulled the trigger and made an account.

Ultimately, I'm looking to write and contribute something. I realize that it'll probably be a long long time before I get to finally publishing, but honestly I think I relish that - no doubt I'll learn oodles of good writing advice in the days to come.

I'm also interested in becoming a advisor/topic expert for medical topics (I'm currently a medical student with a BSc in Biomedical Science), but I'm unsure if I'm too new for that for the time being.

Regardless, I'm happy to be here ^_^. Also I like water because I suck at swimming and I feel like waterbending could make that much easier for me.

Hello, all!

I'm Nerdspartan. I've been interested in SCP since the day I first saw Youtube videos of people playing SCP-087, and later SCP:Containment Breach. Recently, I've stumbled upon the SCP narrative channel TheVolgun, which made me come back to the Foundation.

I love the SCP way of depicting horror in an apathetic and scientific fashion, and I wondered if I could write my own SCPs eventually. So do expect me to post something in the idea critique soon! I will also attempt to do a few critiques of other people's work if I feel confident.

My hobbies include nerdy things like playing video games and making video games (with Unity and RPGMaker), and occasionally writing fictions.

If I were an element, I'd probably be earth, because I am of calm, assertive and thoughtful nature, and I like to live my life steadily, with few unforeseen changes.

Thank you for reading and long live the Foundation!
